messages: run_policy_preferences: Value error, run-policy override '[ ] Company name and slug are set (slug is lowercase-hyphenated)' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] One-sentence description is ≤ 30 words' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] North star is a persistent outcome with a measurable target and timeline (passes the "can this be done in one session?" test — answer must be no)' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] At least 2 goals, all persistent outcomes' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] "We are" paragraph is 2-5 sentences and includes the operational distinctions' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] "We are NOT" list has at least 2 entries' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] At least 2 constraints (real non-negotiable rules, not soft preferences)' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] Use case pattern picked (or explicit `custom`)' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] Governance position picked' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] Hours/week and capital caps filled in' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '[ ] No `[bracketed placeholders]` remain' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '`.paperclip.yaml` — runtime config (sidebar, agents map, projects map)' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '`COMPANY.md` — your identity content (Identity, We are, We are not, Constraints, Goals, North star)' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '`README.md` — auto-generated overview with mermaid org chart' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8'; run-policy override '`OPERATIONS.md` — phase model, idle-state protocol, approval rules, anti-drift checks (v0.1b only)' must name an agent before ':', e.g. 'ceo: max turns 8';
